# Fixture prose

A sentence that names a class and then keeps going in ordinary words. It reaches
no terminator, so the value runs to the end of the line — and reporting it as a
vocabulary violation is the false positive that gets this lint switched off.

판단 부류=감사-발견 인 경우에는 사람에게 묻지 않는다.

The quoted form was never at risk and is kept here so the two stay
distinguishable: `판단 부류=감사-발견` ends at a backtick and is compared whole.
